assertions.name: c3_habiro_3rung_tracks_empirical_across_anchors
assertions.source: Whether the real-q 3-rung [3]_q/25 formula reproduces empirical c_3 at BOTH the proton and muon anchors (genuine fibre rigidity) vs. matching only at the proton anchor (near-match). Expected False — a smooth real-q form cannot track the ~4.6e6 dc_3/dq of the hyper-sensitive extracted c_3.

data.interpretation: The real-q 3-rung [3]_q/25 c_3 closure swings +6.23e-07% across the two anchors while empirical c_3 swings -2.39% (ratio -2.61e-07). The formula is RIGID; it reproduces empirical c_3 only at the proton anchor (miss -2.45% at muon). This CONFIRMS [3]_q/25 is a proton-anchor NEAR-MATCH, not a real-q fibre element — consistent with the known impossibility of a real-q c_3=f(q) matching multiple anchors (AGENTS.md). The genuine Habiro element, if it exists, is complex-analytic / root-of-unity. Falsification test; no fit, no production change.

q0AnchorReason: measures the cross-anchor RIGIDITY of the 3-rung Habiro candidate: the same closed form is evaluated at both pins and its swing compared to the empirical c_3 swing, so both pins are read deliberately and each is reported under its own key
